notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33068365/cc4610ea3901f0c1e02f2e91871f96fafd1e95b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi there Kittens![/b]

It has been a very long journey but finally Kitten'd has been released in all regions on PSVR,Oculus,Steam,Viveport and can be found in hundreds of VR cafes all over the world!

To celebrate this occasion we are currently running a 40% discount on steam!
Big thanks to all the streamers and players who have helped us shape this game into the insane crazy-cat-lady simulator you have today.

We love you all!

notes.title: New patch turns twitch chat into twitch cats!
notes.notes:
During the last weeks we have fixed a couple of crashes and greatly improved performance to help you run Kitten'd even on less beefy computers. We have also added cute steam trading cards that you can collect simply by playing the game.

We have also added support for both LIV and Twitch Integration. Let your viewers become kittens in the game and have twitch chat control the furry demons and wreck havoc in your apartment.

Check out this short clip to see what it looks like:
[previewyoutube=z-Cal3AjheY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1906153584]We made a guide to teach you more about how it all works, click here to check it out![/url]

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Trophies updated to say accessories instead of hats.
[*] Hats no longer unlock in My Room towards the achievement.
[*] Items bought in the sandbox mode now spawn at better spots.
[*] Fixed issue with kittens sometimes not correctly occupying the space they were standing it making it so that other kittens tried to stand in the exact same spot.
[*] Used my brain and math to update pathing in the game. This boosted performance in the entire game by a whole lot.
[*] Fixed crash when picking things up really quick and putting them down REALLY quick!
[*] Add french translation
[*] Fixed issue with usernames on the leaderboards clipping into the scores if they were too long.
[*] Poops in the tutorial level can no longer be removed by dropping them several times on the floor creating a soft-lock. (thanks Zaxtor)
[*] Fixed a rare crash.
[*] Updated the engine to a newer version this should improve performance a bit for everyone.
[*] Fixed issue with the the hat achievement being real easy to get ;)
[*] Rebuilt the tutorial messages, the old system was incredibly expensive.
[*] Added 50+ new random kitten names from twitter. Thanks to all who sent cute pictures and names to us.
[*] Optimized all glass shaders in the game, they might look slightly worse but cost a lot less now.
[*] Fixed issue with the fireman achievement not correctly updating.
[*] Optimized light maps on all levels, this mainly impacts the last half of the levels.
[*] Did a full optimization round on the kittens to, this should mean that you now can have EVEN MORE cats in “my room”.
[*] We now have trading-cards! They are adorable <3
[*] Update the some achievement descriptions
[*] Fixed issue with the cucumber scaring kittens so often the game couldn’t handle it. (tnx S1ege)
[*] Sandbox TV now have a smoother animation when updating the score and the change is shown. We also made the text larger to make it easier to read.
[*] Added helpful popups when kitten’s do something bad!
[*] Fixed green cats looking a lil spooky when they turned.
[*] Added LODs to everything!! So the game should now run a whole lot smoother.
[*] Added a new video option “Mesh Quality” settings this to low will make some parts of the game look a little less pretty but can improve performance.
[*] The unicorn hat now turns poop into rainbow poops. Rainbow poop doesn't leave stains and it tastes fantastic.
[*] You can now force controller options under the gameplay settings. This is useful if you want to play using for example the quest but the controllers aren’t correctly shown.
[*] Streamers can now setup the game to pull names from their twitch chat. This is done under settings -> gameplay -> twitch.
The names that are chosen from chat can issue commands to their cat in the game and even change their look!
If anyone cheers using bits a balloon will appear in the streamers game with the name of chatter that send the bits.
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes two kittens could get the same name from your steam friends.
[*] Added LIV VR support! Check out https://liv.tv/ for more information.
[/list]

Known issues:
The fur shader is currently not working on all graphic cards. We will fix this issue as soon as possible. Sorry :(

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33068365/743b0e106d022cd7e03f8064865317d93e1f1e03.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy hi all you kittens![/h1]
It's been a week since release and we would like to thank you all for your kind words, great feedback and friendly reviews.

During this week we have watched a whole lot of streamers and youtubers play our game. This opened our eyes for a couple of issues and we want to address some of those asap.
Oh ya, we also made it possible for your cuties to fall in love. [b]ADORABLE[/b]

If you want to contact us you can do so on [url=https://twitter.com/KittendGame]our twitter![/url]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with fur-settings being defaulted to 0 instead of 2! Note that fur can be fairly expensive if you feel like the game is lagging behind turn it off in the options.
[*] Added a new option under “Gameplay” called “Arcade Mode”. When turned on each level is much shorter but the kittens are even more needy!
[*] Decreased time for the self-destruct button so that it shows it’s code more often and quicker.
[*] Fixed “Do I get a price” that was supposed to be “Prize”
[*] Fixed expensive gravity machine bubble material.
[*] When holding the glue gun you will now see a ghost image of what you can fix for easier fixing.
[*] Fixed bug where fixed stuff sometimes would come with you into the next level.
[*] Button levels now also name kittens after your steam/oculus/viveport friends.
[*] Increased sound of falling debris in world 3 and added a particle to make it easier folk players to see where it’s coming.
[*] Laser pointer level 2 now has a cute tail laser because.. more laser makes things better.
[*] Fixed a glitch where kitten’s could enter the balcony in 1-6 and escape the room.
[*] Holding two kittens who are happy can make the kittens fall in love! When in love kittens can’t get mad! It’s also adorable.
[*] Fixed issue with kittens sometimes playing without being close to another kitten.
[*] Throwing a ball or having lasers be close to two kittens playing can now distract the kittens and make them play with the toy instead.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause kittens to spin and blink really quickly.
[*] Fixed issue with kittens sometimes being rotated completely wrong and generally going bananas!
[*] Fixed a very rare crash on all headsets.
[*] Fixed a crash related to WMR headsets.
[*] Fixed issue on space levels where things could end up outside causing all kinds of craziness.
[*] Fixed issue where fire at times could start outside of the rooms.
[*] Fixed issue where kitten’s could get stuck in places they shouldn’t be at causing freezing.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33068365/cc4610ea3901f0c1e02f2e91871f96fafd1e95b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]We have finally left early access![/h1]
After 2 years of development and 1 year in early access Kitten'd is now version 1.0!

[b]We want to reach out and give a BIG hug and thanks to everyone who helped us shape this game into what it is today.[/b]

The early access input has been great for us and massive changes have been made based of your excellent feedback. <3<3

[list]
[*] Greatly reduced texture memory usage.
[*] Pointing at a kitten now shows the kitten’s mood if it doesn’t have a specific need to show.
[*] Fixed issue with pointers and holding positions being offset from you controllers.
[*] Improved the VR placement of your controller with the IRL version for all controllers.
[*] Added some resistance when petting kittens.
[*] Fur now reacts on the kitten when you pet it.
[*] Added dynamic sound when you pet kittens that sounds like you are petting fur.
[*] Added a little bit of particles when petting kittens.
[*] The way the game calculates and gives you points for petting a kitten that needs love has changed.
[*] ( Big thanks to @fusedotcore for giving us feedback on this )
[*] FIxed poopiness calculations.
[*] Revamped the stats on kittens in my room a little bit to make them want to play more and poop a little less. (Thanks Rich and Alli)
[*] Removed the handheld laser pointer and added another laser tower instead.
[*] Laser tower 3 now moves the mirrors when lasering making it even more laser.
[*] Added one achievement per cat race when they are picked up.
[*] Fixed several issues with achievements.
[*] Oculus only: Added achievements to the oculus build.
[*] Oculus only: Picking up a cat in the oculus build and getting the achievement will not add the cat to your oculus home.
[*] Oculus only: Kittens will now be named after your oculus friends! <3
[*] Friend names now get clamped in a better way if they are too long.
[*] Improved leaderboard loading.
[*] Fixed a very expensive part when calculating scores.
[*] Oculus leaderboards should now work for both friends and global, oculus does not currently support a “get scores around rank” so instead we now show you your current placement and score.
[*] Fixed issue with the self-destruction button in world 2.
[*] Added a new separate startup screen to make it more clear that my room is a seperate gametype.
[*] Added different music to each world.
[*] Moved around level unlocks a LOT to make the progression with unlock through the story make better sense.
[*] You can now smack the UFOs with things you hold in your hands.
[*] Litter now correctly changes the color of the litter in the litter box.
[*] Glue gun is now a lot more fun to shoot.
[*] Added a limit for poop-smoke to avoid my room getting to steamy.
[*] Changed the startup process so that it fades from black instead of white to avoid blinding players.
[*] Fixed a issue where the persian turned very..horrible at times in my room.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.75.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33068365/743b0e106d022cd7e03f8064865317d93e1f1e03.png[/img]

First off we would like to reach out and thank capt.bradwen for his/her excellent bug-report on the forums. A lot of these changes have been made based of that report alone.

[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Change to triggers on the consoles to make them a little bit smaller (consoles in world 2)
[*] Made consoles in world 2 have a timer giving the player a bit of time to remove the kittens before they trigger them. This is also used to avoid kittens re-triggering the same console over and over again.
[*] Fixed issue with kittens in “my room” not starting in the correct spot.
[*] The “my room” button on the main menu now correctly says “minutes” if you have been away for less than an hour.
[*] Removed the function to move items you can use to avoid confusing the player as you can use all of them from afar.
[*] Added a option under “video” called screenshot mode. When this is checked oculus players can press the right thumbstick down and vive players can press grip 1 to take a high-resolution screenshot! This will slow down the game for a second or two but you will have a pretty picture.
[*] Fixed kittens sometimes leaking from the sandbox into the other levels.
[*] Fixed issue with level 1-7 not always saving the score.
[*] Fixed issue where players would sometimes start on top of a cat box and falling down a little bit when they opened it.
[*] Fixed an issue where players wouldn’t be in the correct level when starting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it so that you couldn’t replay the first level on a new world.
[*] Fixed an issue where spray bottle could be used indefinitely.
[*] UFOs now gets removed once the level is completed and no more will spawn.
[*] Filled up bowls and litter boxes now have the correct filling.
[*] Tweaked score targets for world 2
[*] Fixed the rockstar achievement
[*] Fixed the “complete X levels without breaking anything” achievements
[*] Fixed the “Put out X fires” achievements
[*] Fixed the “Throw 5 poops into the trash” achievements 
[*] Fixed the “Happy Cat” achievement
[*] Shadow casting for kittens are now on by default.
[*] Cheating not correctly turns of achievements.
[*] Fixed leaderboards for world 3 not updating.
[*] Fixed issue with the menu on 3-2
[/list]


[b]"My room" changes[/b]
The “my room” menu has now been split up into 3 sections:
Adopt- lets you adopt new kittens just like before
Remove- lets you remove a kitten by name from your room
Wait- When you press this my room will restart and one hour will have passed. This is a good way to earn more presents by keeping your kittens happy.

There is now a limit on how many cats you can have in“my room”.
To adopt more cats you will need to earn kitten-tokens. You start with 4 of these.
With every world you complete you will gain one more token.
You can also get tokens as presents from you cats.
Cats that you earn in presents does not require tokens so you can have more cats then you have tokens.

Kittens you have adopted in “my room” will now sometimes bring you gifts when you visit them!
If you have been away for more than half an hour a kitten will bring you a gift when you visit them. If you have been away for longer there’s a slight chance you will get even more gifts!
The quality of the gift is determined by the happiest cat you have. If that cat is happy you get a nice rare gift but if it’s sad you might just get poop (literally).

[b]Gifts added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Coin: This gift will give you one more coin to spend in the shop!
[*] Kittens: This gift contains a new random kitten! You can even get kittens you haven’t unlocked yet.
[*] Decorations: Lots of small decorations you can place around your room to make it look nice.
[*] Temporary food: like muffins,chicken etc. You lose no points when kittens eat these things in “my room”.
[*] Poop: It’s a poop given by angry kittens. So rude!
[*] Color guns: You can use these once to change the color of furniture in your room.
[*] Kitten Token: Pick it up and you can have one more cat in “my room”.
[/list]

Here is a full list of what changed in this super-duper-content-patch!

XOXOOXOX

[list]
[*]Fixed sound issues with escape pods.
[*]A whole lot of optimization.

[*]Added new tool in my room “hair color” use this tool on your kittens to change their color!

[*]Made some changes to world 2 to introduce CAT in level and world

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.45.0
notes.notes:
Hi there!
First off all we would like to thank you all for all the great feedback we have received on Kitten'd so far!

A whole lot of people have reached out to us with their ideas and given us feedback and this the very first patch we release has a lot of those ideas implemented.
Please don't be mad if I forgot to thank you!

Not only did we implement your ideas into this patch we also added support for simplified chinese as a language and threw in a bunch of achievements!

Hope you like it!
XOXOXO


[list]
[*]Fixed spawn points for certain tools to make it easier to access them.
[*]You can no longer enter my room without first completing level 1-1 (tnx ,VR2018FR)
[*]You can no longer go to level 2-1 without first completing the first world. (tnx Mastercookie)
[*]Fixed issue with the level select that made it not recognize that level 1-7 was completed.
[*]Poopscoop tooltip now changes when full to make it clear that you need to aim at the trashcan.(tnx Dr Oculus VR)

[*]Added some animations in UI when you adopt a kitten in my room.

[*]Added the first batch of achievements!

[*]Fixed typos

[*]Boxes in world 2 now teleport in from earth!
[*]Made the hover trace line a lot easier to see.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update 2018-07-20
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Kitten'd have now been in early access for almost 2 weeks and we have received a whole lot of great feedback from all of you beautiful people.

We thought we should give you a little update on what we are working on at the moment and what's coming up in the next months.

Our current plan is to finish Kitten'd before the next year.
We have 2 more worlds and 3 more kittens planned.

The next update will contain:

[b]Support for more languages[/b]
Chinese is finished but we are working on more languages. Hopefully we will get German,French and Japanese completed pretty soon.

[b]Improved tutorial[/b]
After watching tons of YouTube videos there are a couple of things that we have explained badly (you can fill bowls and litter-boxes from a far for example). We have improved the tutorials and tool-tips to better explain how the game works.

[b]Achievements[/b]
We will be adding the first set of achievements to the game.

[b]Updated Unreal Engine[/b]
We moved to Unreal Engine 4.20. This should slightly improve performance but also fixes a lot of bugs with the steam integration.

[b]Gameplay additions[/b]
These first weeks have been great for us. YouTubers have opened our eyes to a lot of things we didn't even think about. Things that people have gotten used to when playing in VR (like holding a food dispenser upside down should make food pour out and into the bowl).
A lot of these additions will be added in the next update please keep the feedback coming!

Our current plan is to release smaller patches mainly aimed at improving the current 2 worlds and then in a couple of months release the 3rd world with a whole lot of new content at once!

Thank you so much for support you have been so nice to us!

XOXO
